$comment: Shared wizard/guide explanation data. Classification is checked against _himmel_key_class in scripts/lib/load-dotenv.sh, never defined by this file. Blank answers keep persisted settings or the consumer default; no credentials belong here.

keys.name: HANDOVER_DIR
keys.effect: Handover commands use this existing directory instead of repo-local handovers/.

keys.name: USER_SLUG
keys.effect: Names handover buckets and scratch directories.

keys.name: LUNA_VAULT_PATH
keys.explanation: Absolute path of your luna vault.
keys.effect: Vault tools use this directory when no explicit vault is supplied.

keys.name: HIMMEL_DOC_FRESHNESS
keys.effect: Controls whether documentation drift reminders run.

keys.name: HIMMEL_INITIATIVE
keys.explanation: Comma-separated workflow steps to perform proactively.
keys.effect: Enables named initiative steps, without bypassing their safety gates.

keys.name: HIMMEL_INITIATIVE_AFK
keys.effect: Selects proactive work while the operator is away.

keys.name: HIMMEL_AFK
keys.effect: Changes session guidance for unattended work.

keys.name: HIMMEL_INITIATIVE_OVERNIGHT
keys.effect: Selects overnight proactive workflow steps.

keys.name: HIMMEL_OVERNIGHT
keys.effect: Enables overnight session guidance.

keys.name: HIMMEL_WHERE_ARE_WE
keys.effect: Controls the where-are-we context reminder.

keys.name: HIMMEL_WHERE_ARE_WE_STALE_HOURS
keys.explanation: Hours before a context reminder is stale.
keys.effect: Changes when the session position reminder refreshes.

keys.name: HIMMEL_WORKTREE_NUDGE
keys.effect: Controls reminders to isolate feature work in a worktree.

keys.name: HIMMEL_UPDATE_AUTOSTASH
keys.explanation: Automatic named stash during an update.
keys.effect: Allows the updater to preserve local edits before updating; leave unset to retain its default.

keys.name: CR_PROFILE
keys.effect: Chooses the critics offered by /pr-check, not the review gate floor.

keys.name: CR_CLAUDE_AGENTS
keys.explanation: Claude reviewer agents for the review panel.
keys.effect: Selects which Claude critics take part in review.

keys.name: TICKET_ID_REQUIRED
keys.explanation: Require a ticket ID in commit messages.
keys.effect: 1 requires an ID; 0 permits commits without one, subject to the selected tracker.

keys.name: TICKET_ID_PATTERN
keys.explanation: Regular expression matching a ticket ID.
keys.effect: The commit-message gate uses this pattern instead of its tracker default.

keys.name: TICKET_ID_EXEMPT_AUTHORS
keys.explanation: Authors exempt from the ticket-ID check.
keys.effect: Listed authors may commit without a ticket ID.

keys.name: TRACKER
keys.explanation: Ticket tracker: jira, local or none.
keys.effect: Chooses ticket lookup and commit-message rules.

keys.name: JIRA_EMAIL
keys.explanation: Atlassian account email paired with your Jira token.
keys.effect: Jira requests authenticate as this account; the token stays in the secret store.

keys.name: JIRA_PROJECTS
keys.explanation: Jira projects this installation works with.
keys.effect: Scopes multi-project Jira operations.

keys.name: JIRA_PROJECT_KEY
keys.explanation: Default Jira project prefix, such as ABC.
keys.effect: Selects the default project for Jira commands.

keys.name: JIRA_CLOUD_ID
keys.effect: Selects the Jira Cloud site for scoped-token API requests.

keys.name: GCP_CI_PROJECT_ID
keys.explanation: Google Cloud project used for CI.
keys.effect: Identifies the project for CI cloud resources.

keys.name: SNYK_ORG_ID
keys.effect: Selects the organization for security scans.

keys.name: SNYK_ORG_SLUG
keys.effect: Selects the organization in Snyk URLs and tooling.

keys.name: VERCEL_TEAM_ID
keys.effect: Scopes Vercel operations to that team.

keys.name: VERCEL_USER_ID
keys.effect: Identifies the account for Vercel tooling.

keys.name: ANTHROPIC_API_ORG_ID_A
keys.explanation: Anthropic organization identifier for account A.
keys.effect: Associates API usage reporting with account A.

keys.name: ANTHROPIC_API_ORG_ID_B
keys.explanation: Anthropic organization identifier for account B.
keys.effect: Associates API usage reporting with account B.

keys.name: HIMMEL_REPO
keys.explanation: Absolute path of the himmel checkout.
keys.effect: Lets tooling locate the harness outside its current directory.

keys.name: CLAUDE_HUD_ALLOW_EXTRA_CMD
keys.effect: Enables the HUD's optional extra command when configured.

keys.name: HIMMEL_WHERE_ARE_WE_ROLLUP_TTL
keys.explanation: Lifetime of the cached session-position rollup.
keys.effect: Controls how often the rollup is recomputed.

keys.name: HIMMEL_WHERE_ARE_WE_SEG_TIMEOUT
keys.effect: Bounds how long a segment can delay the reminder.

keys.name: HIMMEL_JIRA_NUDGE
keys.effect: Controls the session-end Jira reminder relay.

keys.name: CR_APP
keys.effect: Selects the review application used by review tooling.

keys.name: CR_PUBLIC_REPO
keys.explanation: Public repository used by review tooling.
keys.effect: Identifies the public review target without changing merge authorization.

keys.name: CLAUDE_END_SESSION_WIKI
keys.effect: Controls session wiki capture at the end of work.

keys.name: SKILL_INDEX_DIR
keys.effect: Skill search uses this index location.

keys.name: ALIBABA_ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL
keys.effect: Routes that provider's Anthropic-format requests to this endpoint.

keys.name: ALIBABA_CODING_PLAN_BASE_URL
keys.effect: Routes coding-plan requests to this endpoint.

keys.name: ALIBABA_DASHSCOPE_BASE_URL
keys.effect: Routes DashScope requests to this endpoint.

keys.name: ALIBABA_OPENAI_BASE_URL
keys.effect: Routes that provider's OpenAI-format requests to this endpoint.

keys.name: CR_REQUIRE_CROSS_MODEL
keys.effect: A true value refuses a Claude-only review panel. Operator-only: edit ~/.himmel/config.json policy by hand; the wizard never writes it.

keys.name: CR_FLOOR_FALLBACK
keys.explanation: Fallback when cross-model review cannot run.
keys.effect: claude-only permits the Claude-only fallback. Operator-only: edit ~/.himmel/config.json policy by hand; the wizard never writes it.

keys.name: ARMAUTOMERGE
keys.effect: A true value arms automatic merging, still subject to every merge gate. Operator-only: edit ~/.himmel/config.json policy by hand; the wizard never writes it.

keys.name: ENV_MIGRATION_CONSENT
keys.explanation: Operator consent for an unattended .env migration.
keys.effect: A true value lets himmel-update run scripts/setup/migrate-env.sh --yes (backup, verify, remove) with no terminal. Operator-only: edit ~/.himmel/config.json policy by hand; the wizard never writes it.
